title: Bost–Connes Spectral Analysis for X₀(143) — Formalization
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Bost–Connes spectral-analysis gates for X₀(143), including the exceptional-prime set S₄ = {2, 3, 19, 191} and the threshold C(S₄) > 2√13. This repository is part of David Fox's Opera Numerorum ensemble.
